laterRuntimeNativeImageChecks.status: Planned only; requires approved fixture/plan/runtime and parent-owned browser routing
laterRuntimeNativeImageChecks.success: Serve exact SVG bytes, assert decode/naturalWidth=1000/naturalHeight=1000 and native image onLoad destination.
laterRuntimeNativeImageChecks.delay: Hold same-origin SVG response, measure reserved viewport before releasing exact bytes; no custom loading placeholder/state.
laterRuntimeNativeImageChecks.failure: Return explicit 404 to resource request, assert native img alt/caption and reserved viewport persist, onError belongs to img; no fallback asset/live message.
laterRuntimeNativeImageChecks.sourceChange: Cache-distinct query URLs with identical approved SVG bytes; inspect currentSrc/events without inferring a custom state machine.
laterRuntimeNativeImageChecks.noOverflowNegatives: Square: all five focal choices coincide. Portrait top/bottom and landscape left/right coincide when that axis has no overflow.

limits: All new capture paths are requests, not files created by the writer; parent owns additional asset edit authorization and capture metadata.

No server, browser, dependency installation, Git/GitHub mutation or asset publication was performed by the writer.
